newsitem.title: USA: MetroNet Comms to use Cascade switches.
newsitem.headline: MetroNet Comms to use Cascade switches.

text.p: Privately held MetroNet Communications Corp will deploy Cascade Communications Corp Frame Relay Multiservice switches in Canada's five largest cities, Cascade said Tuesday.
MetroNet selected Cascade's B-STDX 8000 and 9000 switches as part of its preparation to enter the newly deregulated local exchange market in Canada, Cascade said.
The system allows MetroNet to tie together its Frame Relay and Asynchronous Transfer Mode (ATM) networks.
Frame Relay is a high-speed data network that many telecommunication carriers and large corporate networks are using to handle Internet communication and traffic.
